acpAccount.title: Account & sign-in
acpAccount.description: Stage0 checks the agent automatically when this window opens. Account details come only from the agent; Stage0 never reads or stores its credentials.

acpAccount.savedResult: This is a saved result from this device, not a live account check. The agent does not report account identity or current sign-in status over ACP.
acpAccount.noAccountReported: This agent supports account status reporting but has not reported an account yet.
acpAccount.statusUnavailable: Account status is not reported by this agent over ACP; Stage0 cannot determine whether it is signed in.
acpAccount.noMethod: This agent did not advertise an ACP sign-in method. If it already has a local session, you can still try sending a prompt.
acpAccount.logoutUnsupported: This agent does not support ACP logout, so Stage0 cannot clear its current account before signing in again.
acpAccount.changeAccountNotice: Changing accounts signs out through the agent. For Codex, other clients using the same CODEX_HOME may also need to sign in again.
acpAccount.terminalUnsupported: This agent requires interactive terminal sign-in, which Stage0 does not support yet.
acpAccount.clientSpecificSetup: This sign-in method requires a client-specific setup ({{type}}); Stage0 cannot complete it automatically.
